text.offer: Yes, I desperately need a courier! I will try to put this delicately. I am having... uh... problems with... well, man problems. I am told that Joguer, the apothecary, knows of a powerful aphrodisiac. Please, make haste and ask him of it.
text.complete: You are my savior. Bless you. Here, take this as a token of my thanks.

steps.objective: The egg of a queen spider
steps.brief: Yes, I know of a powerful aphrodisiac: the egg of a queen spider. Fetch me one, and I shall prepare a potion for her.
A fine specimen! Deliver this potion to Madelia. I am sure she will be pleased with the results.
